# Code of Conduct

This project is a place to build software together. Be decent to the people you're building it with.

## Expected

- Assume good faith. Most disagreements are missing context, not bad intent.
- Keep it technical. Criticize the code, design, or idea — not the person.
- Accept that "no" is a valid answer and that a maintainer's time is finite.

## Not acceptable

- Harassment, personal attacks, or demeaning comments, including about someone's identity, background, or experience level.
- Hate speech or sexualized language and imagery.
- Publishing anyone's private information without permission.
- Sustained disruption: derailing threads, repeatedly reopening settled decisions, or filing in bad faith.

## Scope

This applies in every project space — issues, discussions, pull requests, commit messages, and code review — and when representing the project elsewhere.

If you're running an agent that files issues here, you're accountable for what it posts. Read the [contributing guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before pointing one at this repo.

## Reporting

Email **security@caseyjhand.com**. Reports are handled privately, and your identity will not be shared with the person you are reporting.

Maintainers may edit, remove, or lock any contribution that does not fit these guidelines, and block accounts that repeatedly ignore them. Egregious violations may result in an immediate block.
